{{Quote|If you like the cold, you'll love Ando Prime.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Anakin's Speedway">''[[Star Wars: Anakin's Speedway]]''</ref>}}
'''Ando Prime''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was a [[Water/Legends|snow]]-covered&mdash;yet hospitable&mdash;planet. It was the third planet in the [[Ando system/Legends|Ando system]].

==History==
[[File:Ando_Prime_Outlander_Club.png|thumb|left|180px|A [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] seen in the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]].]]
For a long time, the only inhabitants on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] were the native [[Talid/Legends|Talid]],<ref name="sj" /> many of which were [[Order of Dai Bendu]] monks, some of which travelled via the [[Tho Yor]] to [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="DotJ" />

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a group of antique collectors gave off a distress call because they were buried under an avalanche.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Snow-covered Antiques}}</ref>

Sometime during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] would provide an exploration to find a [[Vergence/Legends|Force nexus]] on Ando Prime that was detected by the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]].<ref>{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Power of the Jedi|pack=Obi-Wan Kenobi (Cold Weather Gear)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/potjobiwancold.asp}}</ref>

In later [[Standard year/Legends|years]], the planet had a population surge, following the establishment of several [[Mining/Legends|mining]] communities, including the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Elesa]]. Giant [[Water/Legends|water]] pipes were constructed to supply the growing towns and [[City/Legends|cities]], and took years to finish.<ref name="sj" />

[[File:Ando_Prime.png|thumb|left|A view on Ando Prime]]

Although the planet was covered with snow, it hosted many [[Podracing/Legends|podraces]] during its history. Most of these race courses were controlled and sponsored by the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] clan.<ref name="sj" /> Some of these events were televised across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], even viewed by patrons of nightclubs and sports bars on cosmopolitan worlds like [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref> Ando Prime's podracing courses included:

*[[Ando Overland]]<ref name="sj" />
*[[Beedo's Wild Ride]] - [[Amateur Podracing Circuit]]<ref name="Ep1 Racer" />
*[[Howler Gorge/Legends|Howler Gorge]] - [[Semipro Podracing Circuit]]<ref name="Ep1 Racer" />
*[[Andobi Mountain Run/Legends|Andobi Mountain Run]] - [[Galactic Podracing Circuit/Legends|Galactic Podracing Circuit]]<ref name="Ep1 Racer" />
*[[Ando Prime Centrum/Legends|Ando Prime Centrum]] - [[Invitational Podracing Circuit]]<ref name="Ep1 Racer" />

At some point before [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="hnn">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|sports/13328_1.html|Podracing Faces Uncertain Future}}</ref> aspiring [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Kaeline Ungasan]] attempted to wrest the criminal control of podraces in Ando Prime from the Hutts. He sponsored his own podracing event, the [[Ungasan Cross Country]], whose course changed every time it was run. Ungasan secretly used the Cross Country as a cover for his illegal mining operation of [[Vonium/Legends|vonium]], which was present in Ando Prime. The Hutts sent the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Davon Gitta]] to find Ungasan on Ando Prime.<ref name="sj" /> In 27 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], Ungasan's shady activities and his use of the Cross Country as a front were discovered, in what was the first of many controversies in podracing, leading to the ultimate criminalization of the sport.<ref name="hnn" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[1999]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]'', the name of the planet was {{Pronounced|ɑndəʊ priːm}} (rhyming with "cream") instead of the usual /ɑndəʊ praɪm/ (rhyming with "crime"). Ando Prime is the only planet represented in all four of the game's circuits.<ref name="Ep1 Racer" />
